description:
## Goal

Scenario-auditor rule that guarantees no drift between the three sources of truth: `widgets.ts` declarations, `data-widget=` usages in source, and iframe-bridge runtime widget manifest. Any mismatch fails.

## Expected Work

- Rule in `scenarios/scenario-auditor/api/rules/` that:
  - Parses `ui/src/widgets.ts` for declared widgets.
  - Reuses the static extractor's usage scan for source-side `data-widget` detections.
  - Fetches the runtime iframe-bridge widget manifest from the running scenario UI.
  - Flags: declared-but-unused, used-but-undeclared, declared-but-not-runtime-advertised, runtime-advertised-but-not-declared.

## Acceptance

- Clean pass on a well-formed scenario.
- Actionable failure on each drift category (unit tests per category).
name: widget-authoring-auditor-rule
title: Add scenario-auditor rule comparing widgets.ts, source usages, and runtime manifest
